facilities.costing_tooltip: How this facility values its inventory. "No costs" keeps the current flow. With any other method, every receiving records its unit cost.
facilities.costing_owner_only: Only the owner can change it
facilities.cost_required_on_receiving: Require a cost on every receiving
facilities.costing_change_start: Initializing values this facility's current stock at each SKU's catalog cost (0 when empty) as the opening balance. From then on every receiving recalculates the average.
facilities.costing_change_stop: The facility will stop costing. New movements carry no cost; turning it on again rebuilds the balance from the stock at that moment.
facilities.costing_change_currency: The facility currency will change. With costing off, nothing is revalued.
facilities.costing_change_blocked: Another costing is active. To change method or currency, turn it off first (No costs) and then initialize the new one.
facilities.costing_change_start_specific: Initializing gives every kardex row (tracecard) of this facility its SKU's catalog cost (0 when empty). From then on, a receiving at another price creates another tracecard in the same location, and every exit leaves at the cost of the tracecard it is taken from.
facilities.costing_change_start_fifo: Initializing turns this facility's current stock into one opening layer per SKU at its catalog cost (0 when empty). From then on every entry creates a layer at its own cost, and every exit consumes the oldest layers first.
facilities.costing_change_start_standard: Initializing values the stock at each SKU's catalog cost, which becomes its standard cost. Entries and exits are always valued at the standard; the difference with the real purchase cost is recorded as a variance. If you change the catalog cost, the stock is revalued on the next movement.
